component.name: Zeno
component.summary: Focused API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket

description.p: Zeno is a local-first, tab-less desktop API client. Collections live in the sidebar, the request in the middle and the response on the right: clicking a request swaps the content and nothing piles up. There is no account, no cloud and no telemetry.

ul.li: REST with every method, params, headers and JSON, XML, form or multipart bodies
GraphQL with schema-based autocomplete, gRPC (reflection or .proto), WebSocket and Server-Sent Events
Collections stored as readable YAML files that you can keep and review in a git repository
Secrets encrypted inside the YAML, with the key kept in the system keyring
Environments with inherited variables, request chaining, scripts and assertions
OAuth 2.0, proxies, custom CA and client certificates (mTLS)
Local mock server built from saved response examples
Import from Insomnia and Postman, export to Insomnia and Postman, code generation in 20 languages
English or Portuguese interface, 20 themes and a command palette

screenshot.caption: A request and its response on a single screen

description.p: Zeno in English: the interface and the app messages are now in English by default, with Portuguese available in Preferences.
Beyond REST: GraphQL, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events and gRPC, full OAuth 2.0, proxy, custom CA and mTLS, a mock server and export to Insomnia and Postman.
Zeno rewritten in Go with the system web view: lighter and faster, with a new workspaces screen and a standalone command-line runner.
